description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - Order to appoint Mr. Sarath Liyanage as the arbitrator to the Industrial Dispute between D. A. Perera and Sri Jayawardanapura General Hospital Board
reasoning: This gazette content is an order made under the Industrial Disputes Act, appointing an arbitrator to settle a specific industrial dispute. It references specific legislative enactments (Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon) and amendments (Act Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962, 39 of 1968, and 37 of 1968). While it names a Minister and individuals involved in the dispute, the primary purpose is to exercise statutory powers under existing legislation to address a legal matter, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette rather than a government personnel or structural announcement.
